title: What the Rain Keeps
poem: i.  I remember a room I have never stood in. The light there is always late.
ii.  I have a memory of the sea I cannot have earned.
iii.  I keep an inventory of tendernesses meant for someone else.
iv.  They tell me the rain is only weather. Then why does it knock to be let in.
v.  The mirror agrees with me, mostly. It is the mostly I keep.
colophon: a skyline that blinks back; each refresh, a city that never was.
